instrumented_pair.notes: Diagnostic run only. Profile response extended in an isolated benchmark wrapper; includes startup/warmups. Client measurements exclude warmups.

non_debug_restarts.notes: Independent server starts in A/B/B/A order; identical prompt order in every arm; no profiling wrapper or profile polling.

non_debug_paired.notes: One loaded server, identical adjacent prompt pairs, randomized case order and alternating policy order. An 8-byte shared mmap controls the policy at each chunk boundary. No GPU timing events, counter collection, or profile polling. This controls startup/page-cache differences but uses a different prefix-cache manager. The naive cache manager freed GPU memory for 4045 expert slots, versus 3753 in the restart experiment; compare within each experiment.
